title: Pod CrashLoopBackOff after release
steps: kubectl describe pod / check events for CrashLoopBackOff vs ImagePullBackOff vs OOMKilled
Inspect startup logs for config/exception vs exit code
Compare ConfigMap/env against code's expected keys
Roll back ConfigMap/release or add missing key
Add startup smoke test + config-contract check to pipeline

title: Noisy neighbor CPU contention
symptoms: latency spike on subset of pods
steps: Split latency by node to find contended node
List pods on that node; find CPU-hungry neighbor (missing limits)
Set CPU limits/requests; use node pool / anti-affinity for batch

title: DNS resolution failures (CoreDNS)
symptoms: errors at resolve step before TCP connect
steps: Confirm failures are at DNS resolve, not HTTP from the dependency
Revert to multiple upstreams + prior cache TTL
Add DNS success-rate alarm + synthetic hostname check
